chunks: From him, from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from 'Ubayd
Like it, and he did not say in his hadith: 'Yes'.
ai.seo_question: What is the textual difference in this narration of al-Qasim ibn Sulayman?
ai.summary: This textual variant (ikhtilaf) in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the meticulous attention to precise wording in Shia hadith transmission, where the omission of 'Yes' (Na'am) may subtly alter the affirmative tone or legal implication of the ruling. Such nuances are critical in *usul al-fiqh* for determining whether a statement is an absolute confirmation or a conditional agreement, reflecting the scholarly rigor applied to the authenticity and meaning of the Imams' sayings.
